commands.command:
sed -n '1,240p' <plugin:dakdol@0.1.11>/skills/build/SKILL.md && printf '
---TREE---
' && rg --files -g '!docs/**' -g '!content/**' -g '!*.pyc' | sort && printf '
---STATUS---
' && git status --short && printf '
---DIFF STAT---
' && git diff --stat

sed -n '1,260p' tests/test_s1.py && printf '
---TESTS 261---
' && sed -n '261,620p' tests/test_s1.py && printf '
---PLAN RELEVANT---
' && rg -n -C 3 'Q-(build|post|feed|time|ui)|s1|build.py' plan/PLAN.md mangsang/sources mangsang/concepts -g '*.json' -g '*.md' | head -240

git log --oneline --all --decorate -8 && printf '
---BUILD DIFF CHECK---
' && git diff --check && printf '
---CONTRACT TITLE REFERENCES---
' && rg -n 'short.*title|title.*short|Hello|forbidden' . --glob '!build.py' --glob '!.git/**' --glob '!*.log' --glob '!*.jsonl'

python3 -m unittest tests.test_s1.S1GeneratorContractTests.test_Q_build_recreates_the_feed_posts_assets_images_and_nojekyll tests.test_s1.S1GeneratorContractTests.test_Q_post_short_title_is_forbidden_and_medium_long_titles_are_optional; printf 'EXIT=%s\n' "$?"; python3 -m py_compile build.py; printf 'PYCOMPILE_EXIT=%s\n' "$?"; git status --short -- build.py
